text:
zoe: quick thread: small IA change idea 1: introduce skiplinks and compact breadcrumbs for the console left nav. goal: faster keyboard jumps + one-line breadcrumb presentation on narrow screens.

mira: agree on skiplinks. propose adding a hidden "Skip to: Workspaces | Models | Insights" bar at top of page for keyboard users.

jon: engineering: fine with skiplinks. prefer path-based routing (/app/...) and keeping breadcrumb visuals decoupled from URL segments. avoid hash routing.

sam: a11y notes: 1) skiplinks must be first focusable element, 2) breadcrumbs should use aria-current on last item, 3) when truncating middle crumbs announce "breadcrumb truncated" via polite live region.

lee: UX nit: compact breadcrumb should show "WS > ... > Model" with tooltip showing full path on hover. also use chevron separators.

mira: rollout: feature-flag by workspace; canary 5% then 25%. docs banner + redirect shim for legacy hashes.

jon: I'll prototype the router changes and skiplink focus handling tomorrow. posting a staging link once ready.

sam: will draft quick keyboard test script for QA.

zoe: thanks 1 all, will add spec notes to the design doc and follow up in Fri sync.
